title: Jumpstart Your Job Search - Teal Webinar - October 30th
description:
Ready to 10x your job search this week? Let's help you get your resume ready to land interviews with this week's Jumpstart Your Job Search Webinar. 

Hosted by Teal Recruiter and Social Media Manager, Leah Dillon, we'll walk through getting set up with the Teal Resume Builder and Job Tracker and share valuable job search tips. 

Whether it's building your resume, searching for the right job, or marketing yourself for the role you want, we've got you covered with tools like our FREE Chrome Extension, Job Tracker, and Resume Builder. Head over to www.tealhq.com to get started on your AI-powered resume.

These webinars will share similar information and tips every week, so if you're unable to join live, watch past episodes here on YouTube!

Tune into the next webinar here: https://lu.ma/018386xr
